spec.description:
Kingspan Kooltherm K8 Cavity Board is a premium performance, fiber-free rigid
thermoset phenolic insulation board engineered specifically for partial fill
cavity masonry walls. With an ultra-low thermal conductivity of 0.021 - 0.023
W/m·K and low-emissivity composite foil facings on both sides, it delivers high
thermal resistance while preserving a clear 40mm to 50mm air cavity to resist
moisture ingress. Held against the inner masonry leaf using wall ties and
retaining clips, it is CodeMark certified and manufactured in Australia with
zero ODP blowing agents.
features:
Designed specifically for partial-fill
double brick and brick/block cavity walls

Thermal conductivity of 0.021
- 0.023 W/m·K allows thinner cavities and smaller wall footprints

Clear
residual air space is maintained, resisting wind-driven rain penetration

Low-emissivity composite foil facings significantly increase thermal resistance
of the cavity

Closed-cell phenolic core will not absorb water or slump within
the cavity

Held securely against the
inner masonry leaf using standard brick ties and retaining clips

Fiber-free,
non-deleterious core, safe and easy to handle on site

Manufactured in
Australia with zero ODP and low GWP blowing agents

EPD verified and certified
under GreenTag GreenRate

technical.value:
RT2.2 - RT2.3 (25mm), RT2.9 (40mm) in double brick
cavity walls
1200 mm x 450 mm (sized to suit brick tie spacings)

Suitable for Type
C construction in Class 2-9 and Class 1 & 10a housing

install:
Construct inner leaf of masonry with wall ties
bedded in mortar joints at 450mm vertical and 600mm horizontal centers

Ensure
mortar droppings are cleaned from ties and cavity face before installing
insulation

Place Kooltherm K8 Cavity Boards against the inner leaf over the
protruding wall ties

Secure each board firmly against the inner leaf by
pushing Universal Insulation Retaining Clips over the ties

Stagger board
joints in a brick-bond pattern, butting joints tightly together

Ensure a
minimum 40mm clear residual airspace is maintained between the outer foil face
and outer brick leaf

Lay outer leaf of brickwork, keeping cavity clear of
mortar bridges using a cavity batten
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall
design is partial-fill masonry cavity (double brick or brick/block)

Verify
overall cavity width (e.g. 25mm board + 45mm residual air cavity in a 70mm
cavity)

Select board thickness (25mm or 40mm) to meet required Total
R-value

Order matching 80mm Universal Insulation Retaining Clips (approx. 3-4
per board)
limitations:
A minimum clear residual cavity (typically 40-50mm) must be
maintained to prevent moisture bridging

For Type A and B fire-resisting
construction in Class 2-9 buildings, a Performance Solution is required
Protect boards from excessive mortar droppings during bricklaying

problem_keywords:
heat loss
through double brick walls
thermal bridging across masonry wall ties

meeting NCC
energy ratings in double brick
use_cases:
Partial-fill cavity insulation in double brick residential construction
(especially WA and NSW)

Thermal insulation in commercial brick-and-block
cavity walls held with retaining clips

Slimline cavity insulation maintaining
a certified 40-50mm clear drainage cavity to prevent water ingress
not_for: Full-fill cavities without residual drainage gap

Type A or B
construction without Performance Solution
